priorities.balancedDesc: Equal weight on net margin (30%) and climate resilience (30%), plus water efficiency (20%) and soil fit (20%).
priorities.max_profitDesc: Prioritizes illustrative net margin per ha (55%) among crops that pass seasonal, water, and budget limits.
priorities.min_climate_riskDesc: Prioritizes heat, late-frost, drought, and Starkregen resilience (55%) to protect yield stability.
priorities.min_waterDesc: Prioritizes low supplemental irrigation demand and maximum m³ reserve buffer (50%).

decisionCenter.title: AI Decision Center & Explainable Execution Trace
decisionCenter.subtitle: Recommendations are synthesized by Gemini 4 Carbon strictly from deterministic simulation outputs, audited by an independent Gemini 4 Carbon Critic call, and checked by a deterministic code gate (max 2 review cycles).
decisionCenter.emptyDesc: Click "Execute Agentic Pipeline" to retrieve live DWD ICON / Open-Meteo forecasts, run the Gemini 4 Hydrogen tool orchestrator, generate a localized Gemini 4 Carbon crop decision, and challenge it with the independent Carbon Critic.
decisionCenter.loadingBanner: Executing live DWD/Open-Meteo retrieval, deterministic German crop simulation, Gemini 4 Carbon Decision Agent, and independent Carbon Critic...
decisionCenter.staleLangBanner: This AI evaluation was generated in {{evalLang}}, while the interface is currently set to {{uiLang}}. Deterministic numbers are identical across languages; click below to run a fresh AI evaluation in {{uiLang}}.
decisionCenter.failedBannerTitle: Validation Gate Failed ({{cycles}} Review Cycle(s) Executed) — Mandatory Human Agronomic Review
decisionCenter.advisoryBannerDesc: Hard constraints were satisfied, but climate stress sensitivity or unverified on-farm soil/contract data warrant review by regional official advisors (Offizialberatung / Landwirtschaftskammer) before seed purchase.
decisionCenter.timelineSub: Recorded directly from real server execution steps, tool calls, and validation checks — no fabricated logs.

scenarios.detShiftedScore: Deterministic preview: Under {{scenario}} and updated parameters, {{nextCrop}} overtook {{prevCrop}} on weighted suitability. Click "Evaluate Scenario with Carbon Agents" for full AI trade-off analysis.

dataSources.title: Data Sources, Citations & Assumptions
dataSources.subtitle: AgroVera strictly separates verified public meteorological and statistical sources from illustrative farm-management assumptions, hypothetical climate scenarios, and AI interpretation.
dataSources.classVerifiedDesc: Real-time API observations (DWD ICON / Open-Meteo) or official published German harvest statistics (Statistisches Bundesamt — Destatis).
dataSources.classIllustrativeDesc: Representative German farm-management direct costs (€/ha), farmgate price ranges (€/t), and supplemental irrigation benchmarks structured after LfL Bayern & LTZ Augustenberg.
dataSources.classMissingDesc: Datasets not connected live in this web application (e.g., 30-year DWD CDC station archives, field-specific lab NPK/pH soil tests, daily BLE spot quotes).
